xs.$description: Extra small spacing - 4px. Used for minimal gaps and padding (borders, small icon padding).

sm.$description: Small spacing - 8px. Used for compact component spacing and form field gaps.

md.$description: Medium spacing - 16px. Used for standard component spacing and padding.

lg.$description: Large spacing - 24px. Used for layout padding and major component margins.

xl.$description: Extra large spacing - 32px. Used for section spacing and hero section padding on mobile.

2xl.$description: 2X large spacing - 48px. Used for major layout sections and hero section padding.
